Oh, not bad! He was a hoarder, this one.

Guys, here's something else I heard...
Quiet! Shh! So here it is...
Come on, come on, let me, I'll bash out something...
Now let's check if the hands of a musician still remember how to play...

One guy asks another: Hey, why'd you come to the Zone? I ran from the cops, decided to hide out here. Pfft, what'd you get arrested for? For nothing! They stopped me as usual and nothing's right! Dirty license plates, no first aid kit, ran a red. Right! And against traffic! Yeah, backwards! Drunk and with five guns in the trunk! Well, so what?!
A guy walks into the bar at Skadovsk and says to Beard: Hey, brother, pour me some booze. Beard says: A pint of beer or a shot of vodka? Well fuck, of course a "pint" of vodka.

A stalker returned to the Zone after visiting home, and he's complaining: Listen, I sold some artifacts, bought a car, and it got stolen a week later. Another says: Oh man, that's unlucky, did you go to the cops? He says: I did, they said 'we didn't do it'.

[Note: Classic Russian prison anecdote] A mother sends a message to her son in prison. Son, since you went to the slammer, the house is a total mess. Spring is here, need to dig the garden, plant potatoes and other crap. I can't do it and no fucking idiot will help. The son writes back: Mom, it's actually great. Don't touch the garden at all, just get by. If you dig, they'll add to my sentence and send you to the slammer too. The mom writes a week later: Holy shit, son! After your letter, the cops raided us. They dug up the whole garden, but found nothing. They were so pissed. The son replies: Well mom, I helped how I could. You'll have to plant the potatoes yourself somehow.

Two buddies are sitting around chatting. One says: Listen, bro, we've been friends since we were kids, let me give you a tattoo as a keepsake? The other says: Oh, that's a great idea! Let's do a tank on my back! Just make it look good, get it? No respect, it'll be fucking awesome, I swear. Five minutes pass. The tattooist says: Alright, awesome, done! The other says: I don't get it, why so fast? The tattooist says: What's the problem? It's only four letters.

So, "What? Where? When?" is on. The host says: And now the question will be asked by real guy Vovan. Vovan appears on screen, face all... Dear experts, two months ago my buddy Kolyan borrowed five grand from me and didn't pay it back, the bitch... A month ago Kolyan borrowed three grand and didn't pay it back, the bitch... Last week he borrowed just fifty bucks, but also, the fucking bitch, didn't pay it back! So, the fuck, the question is: who, the bitch, is lying in the black box?!

Give me something better. So the guys talk it over and say: No problem, man. Go pull the gear off corpses in the anomaly field. He thinks it over and says: I get it, boys. So where's that latrine of yours?

Hmm-hmm-hmm, yeah. That's how sad everything turns out.

Not bad, not bad. Two Night Stars in one run. If it keeps going like this, I can kiss your vaunted Klondike goodbye!

Oh, a big piece of meat, straight from the spit. Sizzling, juicy.
They make sausage and bread like crap these days.
It's alright, it's fine, we'll make it. I've been smoking this sky for a reason. Me and my buddies, we'll make it.

What crap. The day's going down the drain. No loot, no profit!
Yeah, I've had fatter hauls on worse days.
This one's as bare as a plucked bird.
You went into the Zone with gear like that?

So, buddy, what have you got there?

You were a resourceful man, buddy.

No, there'll be no talk. Hide your weapon, hide it.
Attention! I'm about to tell a joke...

And then sell it to Sidorovich a hundred meters later. No, you're wrong. The laziest are the traders. I know one... He gets up early specially to do nothing for as long as possible.

Anyway. The Zone. Forest. A clearing. A bloodsucker sits on the doorstep of an old lodge. Then a little bloodsucker runs out of the house. And starts pestering his dad: Dad, oh, dad, come on, show me a stalker... Dad, show me a stalker. The dad goes into the lodge. Comes out. In each hand, a skull. And he starts, like in a puppet show. The left skull in a high voice: Semyonych, do you think there are bloodsuckers here? The right one in a bass voice: You're crazy, Petrukha... What the hell bloodsuckers!
Talk at the checkpoint on the Cordon: Comrade Ensign. Can we... watch TV? Why not, soldier. You can! Just one condition. Don't turn it on!

So scientists decided to conduct field trials of a new drug. They hired a group of stalkers for this. A few days pass. One stalker comes to the professor and says: Hey, did you replace my pills? The professor adjusts his glasses and carefully asks: Why would you think the drug was replaced? The stalker says: Well, it's just... Before, when I threw the pills in a puddle, they sank. And now suddenly they started floating...
They once brought some bigwig to the Zone. To show him the ropes. Some things amazed him. Some things outraged him. And some things... were stolen from him.

One stalker says to another: I always take a photo of my mother-in-law on trips. Why? Well, like this! Cold, mud, anomalies, mutants... And I look at the photo and think... Thank God! It's so nice out here!
A doctor listens to a stalker who came for an appointment. And he says: Good, good, good! Doctor, what's good? - The stalker asks. It's good that it's not me!

Three stalkers share advice. One says: I got a black jacket... Now bandits think I'm one of them. And they don't touch me. The second: I painted my suit so that from a distance it looks like an army vest. The third: I put on an old, torn overalls... And on the back it says. "I'm a failure. Touch me and my bad luck will pass to you." So no one comes within fifty meters at all!

So a stalker comes to a doctor. The doctor examines him and says: This is from fatigue, this is from nervous tension, and this is from depression. Thank you, doctor. Thank you. Tell me, do you have anything besides vodka?

A stalker meets his old friend. He's all beaten up, a black eye. Petya, what's wrong with you? Well, damn. Attacked, beat me up, took my money... Did you at least remember them? What is there to remember? The wife...

One stalker asks another: Do you know what the most stalker car is? No - the other answers - which one? A Zaporozhets! Why? It's simple! Reliable as a tank, and the trunk is in the front. Easy to keep an eye on the loot!

A stalker and a soldier crossed paths near the Cordon. The stalker says: Where are you going? What, man? You crazy? That's military secrets! Hey, don't get excited, I didn't know. So what are you carrying that's so heavy, you're all sweaty? Damn, you'd get sweaty too... Carrying these armor-piercing rounds to the warehouse...

Silence again. The stalker gets angry. Squeezes so hard that it starts dripping down his hand: Listen, you bastard, I'm going to rip it all off! Answer who you are. Fast! Anyway. The Zone. Forest. A clearing. A bloodsucker sits on the doorstep of an old lodge. Then a little bloodsucker runs out of the house. And starts pestering his dad: Dad, oh, dad, come on, show me a stalker... Dad, show me a stalker. The dad goes into the lodge. Comes out. In each hand, a skull. And he starts, like in a puppet show. The left skull in a high voice: Semyonych, do you think there are bloodsuckers here? The right one in a bass voice: You're crazy, Petrukha... What the hell bloodsuckers!

So scientists decided to conduct field trials of a new drug. They hired a group of stalkers for this. A few days pass. One stalker comes to the professor and says: Hey, did you replace my pills? The professor adjusts his glasses and carefully asks: Why would you think the drug was replaced? The stalker says: Well, it's just... Before, when I threw the pills in a puddle, they sank. And now suddenly they started floating...
They once brought some bigwig to the Zone. To show him the ropes. Some things amazed him. Some things outraged him. And some things... were stolen from him.

One stalker says to another: I always take a photo of my mother-in-law on trips. Why? Well, like this! Cold, mud, anomalies, mutants... And I look at the photo and think... Thank God! It's so nice out here!
A doctor listens to a stalker who came for an appointment. And he says: Good, good, good! Doctor, what's good? - The stalker asks. It's good that it's not me!

Three stalkers share advice. One says: I got a black jacket... Now bandits think I'm one of them. And they don't touch me. The second: I painted my suit so that from a distance it looks like an army vest. The third: I put on an old, torn overalls... And on the back it says. "I'm a failure. Touch me and my bad luck will pass to you." So no one comes within fifty meters at all!

So a stalker comes to a doctor. The doctor examines him and says: This is from fatigue, this is from nervous tension, and this is from depression. Thank you, doctor. Thank you. Tell me, do you have anything besides vodka?

A stalker meets his old friend. He's all beaten up, a black eye. Petya, what's wrong with you? Well, damn. Attacked, beat me up, took my money... Did you at least remember them? What is there to remember? The wife...

One stalker asks another: Do you know what the most stalker car is? No - the other answers - which one? A Zaporozhets! Why? It's simple! Reliable as a tank, and the trunk is in the front. Easy to keep an eye on the loot!

A stalker and a soldier crossed paths near the Cordon. The stalker says: Where are you going? What, man? You crazy? That's military secrets! Hey, don't get excited, I didn't know. So what are you carrying that's so heavy, you're all sweaty? Damn, you'd get sweaty too... Carrying these armor-piercing rounds to the warehouse...

A stalker hid his loot in a tree. And one evening decided to check on it. How's it going, is everything intact. And what do you know! Someone's sitting there, rustling, bare feet hanging down. The stalker sneaks up and grabs the one in the tree firmly between the legs. And sternly: Talk, you bastard, who are you? Which faction? Silence. The stalker squeezes harder. Who are you, I ask! Silence again. The stalker gets angry. Squeezes so hard that it starts dripping down his hand: Listen, you bastard, I'm going to rip it all off! Answer who you are. Fast! Then a hoarse, weak voice from above: I'm a Controller... Why the fuck did you keep quiet?! Well, I'm mute...
I'm sick of you! Got it?!
I don't want to chat with you.
I'm not in the mood to chat today.
Listen, I'm tired. I'm not up for conversation.
What's the point of talking to you?
What kind of talk is this now?!
Are you crazy, man?! We'll talk later!
People are shooting, idiot! We'll talk later!
Go fuck yourself with your talk!
First put the weapon away from your hands. Then we'll talk.
Man, if we're going to talk, let's do it friendly-like - no weapons.
During the conversation - no weapons. Got it?
No. There'll be no talk. Put the weapon away.
It might not be over yet.
Quiet! We'll wait a bit longer.
Well? Should we wait a bit more? Just to be sure.
Relax, you! We're all gonna be there.
Don't want the rats to get you? Want me to help you out?
You should be thankful I'm not wasting bullets.
Don't panic, bro. I'm a hell of a doctor.
Don't worry. I've got a medkit. I'll fix you up in a second.
I'll get you back on your feet. No problem.
This is how you'll die... Not from a dog's tail.
That's like someone smeared honey on it!
Not a soul on the horizon. That's good, that's fine.
What crap. The day's going down the drain. No loot, no profit!

They've banded together here. Like animals by the color of their hide. Some were bandits, still are. Others are either protecting us from the Zone or the Zone from us. The soldiers too. For them, gunning down a man is like blowing their nose.
I could use some good food. But there's none.
Yeah, the mood couldn't be worse. And all around is just filth.
Ah, the loot isn't what it used to be. Is it time to quit?
Hmm-hmm-hmm, yeah. That's how sad everything turns out.
Fate... No, you definitely can't escape fate. What's written, will be.
There are tons of rookies these days. Like dogs. And they all know better than the old-timers.
Ah, I really don't want to go hunting for loot today. I wish I were home, in a hammock with a good book.

Some people don't learn a thing. And they don't want to, damn it. They've watched too much American cinema or greed blows their minds. You talk about anomalies, they talk about loot. They don't want to think about anything but money. Until their guts are scattered all over the trees.

I'd like to get my hands on those damn soldiers... They took away all my profit for the month a second time. Bastards. How are you supposed to live if this is how things are going? They just sit at their fucking checkpoints. And live the high life on our backs.
Ah, if only the luck was always like this. Let me calculate... Yes, exactly. Three or four trips like yesterday. And if the loot was just as good. That's it. I'm done with the Zone for good.
But still, I'll save up for my own little house, by a river, with a forest nearby. No radiation, no beasts, no bastards.
Well, we came here, so what? The Center of the Zone, big deal. Artifacts? A cat cried. And as for mutants, I had just as many back at my old place.

And I thought, just you get past the Scorcher, somewhere behind it there's a Klondike of artifacts and a wish granter. What an idiot. Well, you know, my usual dumb luck. Artifacts, my ass. Just untrodden paths and hungry mutants.
I'm so thirsty. Oh, some cold kvass right now. The kind that stings your nose.
Not bad, not bad. Two Night Stars in one run. If it keeps going like this, I can kiss your vaunted Klondike goodbye!

The artifacts here are certainly bigger. It's just that carrying them to Sidorovich is a long way. And the local prices... Damn, if you think about it, it's more profitable to plant potatoes for sale here than to collect loot.
Holy moly, would you believe it, I saw Pripyat yesterday. With my own eyes! If someone had told me a month ago, I wouldn't have believed it.
Oh, a big piece of meat, straight from the spit. Sizzling, juicy.
Concentrates, damn it. And at home? You'd come in the evening, and the wife would put homemade food on the table, hot food, ah.
They make sausage and bread like crap these days.
It's alright, it's fine, we'll make it. I've been smoking this sky for a reason. Me and my buddies, we'll make it.
They slipped me shitty boots again. Don't they have any conscience? The soles fall apart in a week.
Yeah, I've had fatter hauls on worse days.
This one's as bare as a plucked bird.
You went into the Zone with gear like that?
No use letting good stuff go to waste, that's what I think.
So, man, what have you got there?
Sorry, of course, but you don't need it anymore.
You were a resourceful man, buddy.
Don't mess around! Hide your weapon!
I'm not going to talk to you.
I don't feel like chatting with you.
I'm not in the mood to talk today.
What kind of talk is this now?!
Are you crazy, man? We'll talk later!
There's shooting, idiot! We'll talk later!
If you need something, ask the chief.
Listen, all questions to the chief.
That's the senior over there, so talk to him.
First put the weapon away from your hands, then we'll talk.
I don't like talking under a gun, man.
No, there'll be no talk. Put the weapon away.

No. There'll be no talk. Put the weapon away.
The Zone! The Zone, bitch! I'll get out anyway! I will!
*Moans* It hurts... it hurts, oh, it hurts... *Moans*
Find artifacts... find artifacts... find artifacts... Lots of them...
And at night, how it shines!.. he-he... he-he-he... Beautiful!.. like the sun... he... he-he... only cold!..
A little more... and home... eh... I just need... to find the way... eh...
Loves me... Loves me not... Loves me!.. Loves me not...
It hurts... it hurts, oh, it hurts...
Rita, we'll be back soon... Don't worry, sweetie, ok?
My daughter, my little girl. You've gotten so big... Dad will be back soon...
Little daughter... You've gotten so big... Dad will be back soon...
It hurts... Don't want to hurt... don't want to.
Everyone wants to live, right? Huh? Victim of circumstance.
What the fuck do I need you for?
What's the point of you living, huh?
So why the hell are you whining, huh? So you caught one. I'll fix you, I'll fix you.
Calm down. People don't die from scratches. I'll help.
Are you a man or a woman? Why are you crying? I'll patch you up somehow.
Oh, I'm done for... Sure as hell.
Oh fuck. Now that's getting it. Got it in the balls.
Just in time, I would've croaked here.
I could go for some shish kebab right now, with greens, and a good wine.
Ah, fuck them all, they're cowardly comrades. No trust in anyone.
No, they'll piss me off, I'll shoot them all to hell. One gang, they call themselves, they've completely lost it, eyeing someone else's loot.

Yeah, you gotta be kidding me. Messing with us. Our talk is short, rules simple. Hand over the loot - you live. Don't - welcome to the next world. Well, nothing, they'll remember this for a long time.
Not the same profit these days. Used to be, you could make a good bundle in one raid. Now it's not that. And good contracts have been shitty lately.
No, I did the right thing. If any bastard goes through my stuff...
I've had it! Ugh, I've had it, Zone! To the grave! If only there was somewhere to lay low, but there's nowhere. No one reliable here or there. What a fucking destiny!
How I carved up that stalker... Like an artist, damn it. Like Picasso, straight up.
I think we'll be done in two days, that's all there is. We just need to do it without too much noise.
Soon, soon, and then the sea, the sun, a yacht, cognac for ten bucks... The most expensive chicks.
If that bastard gets in my way again... I don't give a shit about rank, I'll paint him so... His own mother won't recognize him!
Yeah, darkness can be an enemy, or it can be a best friend.
So. What edible stuff do I have left? Or just get by for now?
Hmm, I wonder how much I've saved up in my stash? I haven't counted in a while...
No, you can't trust anyone. They're all dogs, all want to sink their teeth into your throat!
I need to start asserting myself properly, so they don't think about pulling a fast one, so they all shake at the sound of my name.
Yeah, women - they're great. Just no place for them here. No, definitely no place.
Yeah, sleep tight, you broke ass.
Figured as much. Could have not wasted the time.
Well, this one definitely had nothing to lose.
So, dear sir, what are we rich with?
Excellent! If only it were always like this.
Oh, well this will all come in very handy.
Now that's a thank you, dead guy.
And this is for the road.
And here's a fig for you.
You want to live, don't you?
Hold on, brother. We'll patch you up.
Easy, easy, I'm here. We'll fix you up a bit and it'll be fine.
There, there, stop moaning. I'll help now.
Damn, how did I get it? How's that, what about the guys?
And where's the salt in that?
He's a hundred years old and that beard is so old.
Listen, you should stop with the jokes, honestly, I'm sick of it.
Maybe I should learn to play myself...
Eh. I'd love to crash and sleep for about six hundred minutes.
What about my guys? What's happening with them? If only I knew.
My squad... They're all gone. No one left.
Man, I'm completely worn out. Totally. But I can't get soft yet... Oh, I can't.
When we get back, whoever survives...
The Zone... We're all part of the Zone now. Head to toe. I can navigate it anywhere without a map.
And the beasts here... Well, people aren't much better.
Well, if we're lucky. We'll find those who started all this, and we'll have a chat. A heart-to-heart chat. Man to man.
A soldier has eternity ahead. Don't confuse it with old age. The cuckoo... It's not good here with cuckoos. No one to ask the time.
Look at the beasts, they're always fine. Found a clearing with mushrooms, there's your table. And you have to carry your rations if you go on a week-long raid.
No, but Freedom... A real joke. A bunch of stoned morons ran into the Zone. Although, in combat matters, they know a thing or two... Can't argue with that.
Eh. When I get back, after all this, any place will be good, any dump.
Eh, weather, weather, why are you so changeable?

*Yawns* What, defender of humanity, feeling sleepy? You can't, you can't. People are counting on you. As if... Counting... They don't know a damn thing about us. And to hell with glory. I just want to deal with this Zone.
Damn, what freaks... Freedom gives everything for free. What freedom is that? Release the beasts outside the perimeter? You're crazy yourselves, so step aside, don't interfere with the work.
No, what do these Freedomers want? To leave the Zone alone? How can you leave something like this untouched? It's not a nature reserve, damn it, death is everywhere.
Ah, if only all sorts of freaks didn't get in the way... Maybe we would have cleaned out the Zone completely by now.
This situation is pretty shitty. We've been sweating here for so long, and there's almost no backup.
Oh, so much crap here... Clean it and clean it.
Well, look at us... Sitting together with Freedom, damn them... in the same sandbox... Eh, if only I could find a safer bunker. Set up a base there, by all the regulations.
I should've stocked up on more hardtack. As if I knew.
Oh, my hands are just itching to beat the face of someone from Freedom. And we've beaten them our whole lives, and now, you see, we can't. Orders. Screw those orders.
Oh, I feel something bad is going to happen soon, oh, something bad...
These places are really wild. They sent a group to find a passage to Pripyat. And the group... no sign of them, like they vanished into thin air. Gone.
I should take more ammo. Who knows what kind of evil we'll run into on the road.
Geez, I forgot to check the old stashes again, hope no one rummaged through them.
Phew, I'd like to have a good proper meal right now.
No, anyway. Until we fix the Zone, we won't leave here. We have no right. God forbid something crawls out into the world...
Yes, that's the job - protecting others. I'd also like to know who's responsible for this whole circus.
Well... The gear's like on that Bedouin.
You were pretty poor though, man.
Let's see what you're rich in.
Good thing I wasn't too lazy to rummage.
Got any good news for me?
Won't be able to talk, sorry.
Any questions, see the squad leader.
Any questions, go to the commander.
Put your gun away, then we'll talk!
So, either put the gun away or get out of here!
When you hide your weapon, then we'll talk.
There's too many of you, dammit!
And here's something else I heard...
I'll play something for you now. Just need to be able to play it...
Eh, without music there's no joy...

So a stalker saved up some money. Bought himself a little house by the river. Drank to celebrate. Morning after, hungover, he goes into the shed... bangs his head on the doorframe. Steps on a rake. Jumps back. Slips on a cowpat. Falls into a pig trough... Then a shovel falls off the wall and hits him on the back. The stalker comes to in the shed and whispers: And after this, let anyone tell me that anomalies only exist in the Zone.

A group of Freedomers went on a raid. They walked and walked. Decided to take a break. Sat down. And they got high. And they started blasting away in all directions! They shot until they were empty. When it got quiet, a stunned lone stalker gets up from the bushes... What are you doing, guys? What do you mean, man... We barely fought them off! From those... What're they called... Uh... Oh! Those! Crows! Yeah, crows! What? Yeah. Know them? They're so aggressive... Scary! With beaks...

Two Freedomers are sitting there. Smoking. Then one of their dachshunds runs in. The other asks: Your dog's legs seem kind of short... The first one looks carefully: Nah. They seem to reach the ground...
So two Freedomers are sitting and thinking: I think we need to get really drunk to make a decision... And the other says: And I think... to get drunk, you don't need to make any decision at all.

A bloodsucker is wandering through the forest: really hungry. And as luck would have it, not a single stalker around. Then another bloodsucker runs towards him... With blood dripping down his face. The first one asks: Oooh... You're so lucky... Where'd you get that?! The other answers: See that tree on the hill? The thick one? I see it. Well, I didn't...
One Freedomer says to another: You know... I'm never, ever going to eat mushrooms again. Why not? I promised them yesterday...
Two Freedomers are sitting. They smoked. One says to the other: I heard a thing... Weed halves your life! How's that? Well, how old are you? Like, twenty-five. Well see! Without weed, you'd be fifty!

So two Freedomers are sitting on a hill. High as kites, obviously. Then suddenly. A bloodsucker jumps at them from the bushes. The first Freedomer hears the noise. Lifts his head... And freezes. Fuck... A bloodsucker. The second one also lifts his head and says thoughtfully: Oh damn... Same thing.

A Freedomer is sitting outside in Limansk. The sun is warm. He's dozing in it. Then he sees: a stalker walking. And heading straight for a "Carousel" anomaly. The Freedomer says to him: Mister... Hey, mister... That's... Oops...

Once a Freedomer comes to a medic at Yanov. And complains that he's been feeling bad lately. The doctor looks him over. And says: Well... You'll need to undergo treatment. Drink some herbal tea. The Freedomer's eyes just popped: Doc, you're tripping! Next you'll tell me... to smoke syringes.

And people, huh? Idiots. They believe anything they're fed on TV. And they do anything they're told. They don't want to think for themselves. Eh, I'd like to shake them up good so they'd open their eyes.
I wish they'd slip us some decent goods, since it doesn't grow here. But it's always a letdown: either no buds, or it's coughy...

The Training Grounds... No, that's just great, what did they think up? It's such a unique place. You could study it, make discoveries, tell people. No-o-o, the bastards keep quiet. Or tell scary stories. And anyone who tells the truth or wants to live on their own, they immediately put their boot on their neck. Assholes.
No-o-o, you can't play nice with them. Neither with the Army, nor with Duty. They don't want to play nice. They kill us, so we'll kill them until they get it!
Yesterday we ate kasha at the base. The day before we also ate kasha. And tomorrow what? We'll be eating that crap again?
Our service is both dangerous and hard. And at first glance, it's like it's invisible. On second glance, it's also like it's invisible. Even on the third.

Damn, everything's so shitty... All around there's nothing but funk and stupid buzzkills.

Eh, it'd be awesome to pop some good stuff right now.

So, a stalker and Shulga, the Duty commander, are talking. Shulga says: So, you want to serve with us? I'd be honored! But only as a general! Shulga, of course, is taken aback. He paused, gathered his thoughts, and then he yells: Are you an idiot? The stalker thinks. Listen, mister, is that a mandatory condition, huh?
Once a Flesh saw a Dutyer nearby, and it oinks to its piglets: Quick, kids, cover your ears. He's about to miss us and start swearing so much...
Two Monolithians meet. One has a broken arm. One: In Pripyat? Second: In Pripyat... Duty? Yeah, Duty... Shot or grenade? No... Stepped on one.

TV people came to the Zone to shoot a story. They caught one of our guys somewhere and ask: What do you think about the army, about military personnel? They're freaks, freaks, no doubt! All they know is to fleece stalkers! They're afraid of mutants, don't do a damn thing! In short, they're totally out of their minds! The TV people: Yes, such sincere outrage, frankly, makes you think... What can you say about the Duty faction? Our guy paused, thought. You know, dudes, I think... I was too harsh about the military. Globally speaking, they're not that bad, people, alright.

Once Duty members come to Noah's Ark, and they knock on the door. They knock and knock, but no one answers. So they really get going, they start just ramming it. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a pseudodog appears and says: Guys, stop breaking the door, no one's home. The Dutyers faint. The toughest one comes to, carefully moves away from the dog, and stammers: Y-y-y-you b-b-bastard, c-c-couldn't you just bark? And the beast says to him: Of course I could, I just didn't want to scare you. You're some kind of nervous guys.

So, two soldiers decided to tease the ensign. Comrade Ensign, which is heavier: a kilogram of cotton or a kilogram of iron? Well, a kilogram of iron, of course, says the ensign. Wrong! A general instructs his staff. And remember: very often after a battle test, it turns out that a reliable rear is actually a defenseless ass.

What a conscious soldier they've got! And the conscript continues: I told the military commissar a hundred times! I've got no business in the Zone. But he's such a bastard.
